text:
Predicates:
DeadlyDisease(x) ::: x is a deadly disease.
LowSurvival(x) ::: x comes with a low survival rate.
SevereCancer(x) ::: x is a severe cancer.
BileDuctCancer(x) ::: x is a bile duct cancer.
Cholangiocarcinoma(x) ::: x is a Cholangiocarcinoma.
Premises:
∀x (DeadlyDisease(x) → LowSurvival(x)) ::: If something is a deadly disease, then it comes with a low survival rate.
∀x (SevereCancer(x) → DeadlyDisease(x)) ::: Severe cancers are deadly diseases.
BileDuctCancer(bileDuctCancer) ∧ SevereCancer(bileDuctCancer) ::: Bile duct cancer is a severe form of cancer.
∀x (Cholangiocarcinoma(x) → BileDuctCancer(x)) ::: All Cholangiocarcinoma is bile duct cancer.
LowSurvival(mildFlu) ::: Mild flu comes with a low survival rate.
¬(BileDuctCancer(colorectalCancer) ∧ LowSurvival(colorectalCancer)) ::: Colorectal cancer is not both a bile duct cancer and with a low survival rate.
Conclusion:
SevereCancer(colorectalCancer) ::: Colorectal cancer is a kind of severe cancer.
